title: MOX
subtitle: Creative studio
summary: A full-cycle creative studio from Warsaw: branding, websites, UX/UI, design support and AI integration.
task: Give the studio a social media presence as strong as its own work — one that explains what MOX does without a pitch deck.
role: I ran MOX's social media: the visual style, feed posts, stories and ad creatives.
approach: Objects only, no people. Matte 3D keycaps and the teal ring from the logo carry every visual on a dark base with brand teal. Familiar interfaces act as scroll-stoppers: Instagram stickers, a DM chat, a search bar, notifications, Figma cursors.
scope: Social visual style: palette, type, 3D objects, effects
6 feed posts incl. a two-part panorama
6 interactive stories: poll, quiz, slider, progress, DM chat, link
4 ad creatives (4:5) with Meta Ads copy
Captions, story and ad texts in English
